ready_x50_asset.name: Zolee_Dreame_X50_HU_Elison_Ready.tar.gz
ready_x50_asset.format: full robot-ready tar.gz, 611 OGG and 6 model metadata files
ready_x50_asset.distribution: Private use only pending factory-audio and Elison-voice rights review

notes: The factory archive contains 611 OGG files but only 589 final Hungarian texts and corresponding audio recordings.
The source sidecar's 594 replacements should not be interpreted as 594 unique finalized Hungarian texts.
The overlay ZIP should be used for redistribution and adapts the 589 generated files to each robot's official language pack.
Private GitHub Releases require repository access; unauthenticated in-app HTTP downloads will fail.
